summary: OpenAI announced a program allowing approved 'Daybreak' partners to use its frontier cybersecurity models to deliver authorized, governed cybersecurity services to customers.

practices.reason: The program gates access to frontier cyber models behind an approved-partner licensing structure, which a team seeking such access would need to navigate.
practices.quote: Approved Daybreak partners can use OpenAI’s frontier cyber models to deliver authorized, governed cybersecurity services to customers.
